title: Find Your Hydration Personality
subtitle: A short, shareable personality quiz that turns your daily water intake into a fun personality, an emoji, and some chill advice.
tone: Playful, never preachy. No judgment. Your body is just curious.

questions.question: How many glasses (about 250 ml) of water do you drink on a typical day?
questions.subtitle: The foundation question! Feel free to switch between glasses and litres.

options.tagline: A casual sip now and then

questions.question: What's the first thing you drink in the morning?
questions.statement: The very first drink I reach for after getting out of bed is a glass of water.
questions.fact: Drinking water first thing helps kickstart your metabolism and clears out nighttime cellular waste.

questions.question: How often do you carry a water bottle?
questions.statement: My reusable water bottle goes everywhere with me like an emotional support buddy.
questions.fact: People who keep a reusable bottle within arm's reach drink up to 40% more water throughout the day.

questions.question: You feel thirsty. What do you do?
questions.statement: When I notice I'm thirsty, I immediately stop and grab a drink instead of postponing it.
questions.fact: Thirst is your body's late alert system — responding right away prevents the afternoon brain fog.

questions.question: How much do you drink during meals?
questions.statement: I routinely sip water alongside my meals and snacks throughout the day.
questions.fact: Sipping water with food aids smooth nutrient absorption and keeps your stomach enzymes balanced.

questions.question: On a hot or busy day, what happens to your water intake?
questions.statement: Even during chaotic deadlines or back-to-back meetings, my hydration remains on point.
questions.fact: Under stress, the body releases cortisol which increases fluid loss — keeping a water cue helps you stay grounded.

questions.question: How would your friends describe your relationship with water?
questions.statement: My friends would describe me as someone who is constantly sipping or talking about hydration.
questions.fact: The brain is about 73% water. Staying hydrated is quite literally feeding your brain clarity!

cactus.name: The Cactus
cactus.vibe: Runs on vibes and occasional chai
cactus.description: You are biologically equipped to survive the desert on sheer willpower and iced coffee. Water is basically a myth you've heard whispers about.
cactus.chillAdvice: Keep a bottle where you can see it. Take a sip every time you unlock your phone. Tiny wins count.
cactus.waterTwin: A resilient desert succulent living on sunbeams and optimism

superpower.title: Superpower: Extreme Grit
superpower.description: Can pull an entire 8-hour workday on 2 drops of liquid and sheer vibes.

growth.title: Growth Area: Visible Cues
growth.description: Deep in a work spiral? Your water bottle sits untouched. Put it right next to your keyboard!

casual_sipper.name: The Casual Sipper
casual_sipper.description: You've got cute tumblers and great intentions, but out of sight is out of mind. You drink when someone else takes a sip or your mouth feels like toast.
casual_sipper.chillAdvice: You're close. Add one glass with each meal and you're there.
casual_sipper.waterTwin: A curious housecat that only inspects running tap water occasionally

superpower.title: Superpower: Social Hydration
superpower.description: Ready to drink whenever prompted by your environment — you just need a friendly nudge.

growth.title: Growth Area: Routine Anchors
growth.description: Relying on thirst alone means hours pass unnoticed. Anchor a sip to your daily habits!

steady_turtle.name: The Steady Turtle
steady_turtle.description: Unshakeable, calm, and quietly disciplined. You don't make a big scene out of drinking water; you just keep an easy, continuous pace.
steady_turtle.chillAdvice: Solid pace. Try a glass right after waking up for a bonus boost.
steady_turtle.waterTwin: An ancient sea turtle gliding peacefully along the reef current

superpower.title: Superpower: Unflappable Flow
superpower.description: You maintain a solid baseline day after day without needing fancy alarms or drama.

growth.title: Growth Area: Morning Kickstart
growth.description: You're great during the afternoon, but a morning glass could give you an early glow boost.

happy_dolphin.name: The Happy Dolphin
happy_dolphin.description: You have mastered the art of cellular happiness. Your skin is radiant, your organs are cheering, and your water bottle has personalized stickers.
happy_dolphin.chillAdvice: You've got it figured out. Keep your bottle handy on busy days.
happy_dolphin.waterTwin: A joyful dolphin performing backflips in sparkling turquoise waves

superpower.title: Superpower: Radiant Instinct
superpower.description: Hydration is second nature to you — intuitive, effortless, and genuinely energizing.

growth.title: Growth Area: Meeting Defense
growth.description: Keep that bottle filled before back-to-back calls so your flow doesn't hit a dry spell.

water_whale.name: The Water Whale
water_whale.description: A magnificent aquatic legend. You carry gallon jugs without hesitation, your bathroom visits are legendary, and you are approximately 99.4% pure water.
water_whale.chillAdvice: Respect. Listen to your body and balance with meals. Hydration is a vibe, not a competition.
water_whale.waterTwin: A mighty blue whale roaming the open ocean in supreme majesty

superpower.title: Superpower: Peak Circulation
superpower.description: Immense fluid stamina that leaves dry dehydration in another dimension.

growth.title: Growth Area: Electrolyte Harmony
growth.description: Remember to balance with healthy salts & snacks — water is a vibe, not a speedrun!
